journey.name: ED-09 Saving a task the source has forgotten reports NotFound over the form
journey.description:
The one path on which DataError.NotFound is reachable from the UI, and the reason it is worth a journey where Timeout and Conflict are not: TaskEditorViewModel keeps taskId in SavedStateHandle, the FakeTaskApi store is rebuilt from SEED_TASKS whenever the process restarts, and ids are handed out from a counter that restarts with it. A task created in this session gets task-5; the next process knows only task-1 to task-4. The editor comes back over a task that no longer exists, and updateTask throws NotFound rather than a dice roll.
What is being checked is that the save failure is treated as a save failure: the form and every field in it survive, the message names the real cause, and the user is not silently returned to the list as though the edit had landed.
The save-error snackbar is SnackbarDuration.Short - about four seconds - so start the dump within a second of the tap. Read qa/README.md, "Two things that will waste a run if you miss them".
Note that `am kill` restarts the process with failureRate back at its 0.15 default, which is why the rate is set again after the app is reopened.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type "Written on sand" into the "Title" field
Tap the "Save" button
Verify that "Written on sand" is on screen
Tap the "Written on sand" row
Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Press the Home button
Using adb, kill the app process with `am kill com.rounds.test.to_dolist`
Reopen the app from the recents list
Using adb, set the failure rate back to zero with `am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 0.0`
Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Written on sand"
Replace the contents of the "Title" field with "Written on sand and gone"
Tap the "Save" button
Verify that "This task no longer exists." is on screen
Verify that the title "Edit task" is still on screen
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Written on sand and gone"
Tap the element with the content description "Back"
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen with exactly four rows
Verify that "Written on sand" is not on screen
